description: Click here and download the Dusty Comic Procreate Brushes X 18 graphic · Window, Mac, Linux · Last updated 2026 · Commercial licence included ✓
fullDescription:
These hand created Procreate digital brushes are perfect for creating fun comic pieces – you can mix and match on various projects.

This brush pack includes 18 individual digital brushes – including paper textures that you can use on their own or using a light colour, as an overlay. The kit also includes inkers, texturisers, and paint brushes.

The brushes can be resized using the brush resize tool in Procreate, or by using the move and resize tool. additionally the strength of the blend/ink charge can be altered by using the opacity slider and or blend modes.

See listing pictures for brushes included.

These files are digital brushes that will only work within the Procreate App. To be able to use them you will need an Apple Pencil and the Procreate App installed on an iPad Pro. This will not work without this.
– To download and install the files you will need a platform to download the files to (eg iCloud) and a program to be able to unzip the files (for eg iZip). Once you have done this the files will then be imported to Procreate within a named folder.
